stem: Over the past 12 months the MRR of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, grew 25%, while its 12-month net revenue retention was 92%. What does this tell you?

options.text: Last year's businesses upgraded enough to explain the growth
The MRR figure must be wrong, since NRR below 100% means MRR fell
No business cancelled, but some moved to cheaper plans
Businesses that joined or came back during the year drove the growth
